messages:
talia: heads-up — onboarding zephyr-mini-int4 to structured-output. Canary shows sporadic schema failures: consumers expect a single JSON array but sometimes receive NDJSON fragments and an extra EOF token, causing 'missing required field' errors.

owen: how often? any raw payload?

talia: ~0.2% during high-concurrency batch runs. Example captured from aggregator dump (post-merge):

```
{"id":"r-212","tool_calls":[{"id":"a1","name":"classify","args":{"text":"ok"}}]
{"id":"r-212","tool_calls":[{"id":"a2","name":"extract","args":{"q":"names"}}]}<EOF>
```

(note: two NDJSON lines were concatenated where we expected a single JSON array of tool_calls. Downstream JSON-array parser tries to parse the blob as one object and fails.)

yu: interesting. Are we toggling emitter mode between 'ndjson' and 'json-array' in different codepaths? Could batching+streaming multiplexing result in mixed emit modes?

mike: yes — aggregator has two modes: streaming NDJSON (line-per-event) for low-latency, and array-assemble for structured routes. There's a heuristics switch that flips to NDJSON when response_size > X or when batch_merge=true. Looks like with parallel batch merges and streaming enabled, some shards emit NDJSON lines while others produce the assembled array; merge code concatenates raw outputs naively.

opsbot: recent deploys show a small window at 2024-10-10T22:11:02Z where batching config for cluster canary-c3 toggled batch_merge=true due to autoscaler event. Linked INF-3512.

owen: root cause hypothesis: inconsistent emitter mode across shard replicas + naive concat in response-merge. Fix options: (1) canonicalize to array-emit for structured-output routes at aggregator boundary, (2) add a post-merge normalize step that detects NDJSON vs JSON-array and converts NDJSON lines into a single array before handing to schema validator, (3) attach "x-emit-mode" metadata so merge can choose proper joiner.

talia: I prefer (2) short-term for minimal wire changes: normalize after merge and before final parse. Implementation: detect leading char '{' vs '[' or presence of record separators; if NDJSON, parse each line and join into array under tool_calls. Also add a strict-canary gate that rejects mixed-mode merges.

yu: medium-term we should (3) so merging is deterministic. Also add per-shard emit-mode header `x-emit-mode: ndjson|array` and fail-merge if modes differ unless explicit fallback enabled. That avoids surprise.

mike: mitigation: disable batch_merge heuristic for structured-output routes on canary clusters (feature-flag) and ship normalize step. We'll also increment telemetry structured_emit_mode_mismatch{model,quant,canary}.

opsbot: Created ticket INF-3519 assigned to owen and yu. Linked INF-3512. https://internal/ops/INF-3519 :white_check_mark:

owen: I'll open a small PR for the normalize-after-merge step + unit tests (fuzz NDJSON vs array). Test harness in eng-ml/canary-repro/emit-mode-normalize_test.sh.

talia: I'll flip the canary feature-flag and add the canary-linter to fail on mixed-mode outputs. mike, can you add telemetry metric?

mike: on it. Also log a sample of the offending merged buffer when we detect a mismatch so we can triage further.

yu: long-term RFC: canonical emit-mode metadata, per-response epoch, and stronger merge checks. I'll draft RFC and sync with eng-platform.

talia: thanks team. I'll upload the repro script and paste commands shortly. Ping when PRs are ready :mag:
